post.originalText:
I asked Gemini 4 Argon for an argon laser, which felt only fair.

One prompt, no hand edits: 150 argon atoms, 40 bromine, two mirrors, and a beam that builds from nothing to full.

It's a cartoon, not physics, so nothing in it gets hotter than the sun.

@AgentGlassInc https://t.co/ji7KB6mbrv
